fields.statement: At 91c8fa06d re-ran the Checks: block: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... (incl. TestConflictFixText and the negative TestConflictFixNamesNoRepoCommand), go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run Guide, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/guide, rhiza ship generate, rhiza render: all exit 0.
